notes:
Summary: Nightingale Capital Research (global comms desk + PM research) has ~12M source documents (research notes, filings, transcripts). Wants a two-stage retrieval: vector ANN -> lightweight candidate rerank -> optional cross-encoder for high-value queries. Prefers Redwood Dedicated behind VPC; must bring their KMS keys.

Key quotes: 'We can't send primary datasets to a multitenant key store' / 'Need predictable tail latency for trader-facing search'.

Constraints: EU clients require residency for derived vectors, retention controls for PII removal, SOC2 evidence, vendor KMS handoff process. Cost sensitivity on per-query rerank—expects Redwood Optimize suggestions on batching and quantization.

Requested artifacts: dedicated pricing sheet, SLA for p95 latency, KMS integration runbook, sample POC config for 250 qps retrieval + burst to 1k qps.

CRM shorthand: pref dedicated > private; want to avoid cross-region proxying; legal reviewing T&C; security to run pentest after POC.
